From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-10-20T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: three-window demo proposal + procurement & security intro

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

- Goal: 45–60m technical deep dive (SSO, data isolation, retention, performance SLAs) for platform + security + procurement.
- Proposed windows (PT):
  1) Tue Oct 26, 10:00–11:00
  2) Wed Oct 27, 14:00–15:00
  3) Mon Nov 1, 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which of the three works best? If none, tell us two alternatives and we’ll adapt. Also: can you loop in procurement and the person on your side who owns security/compliance? I’m cc’ing Marissa (pricing) and Sean (customer success) so they can join the deep dive and prep the procurement checklist.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP_Horizon_v1.xlsx) for the pilot timeline — feel free to redline. I’ve also attached a short SOC2 summary that Priya will follow up on more concretely once we loop security.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_Horizon_v1.xlsx], [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf]

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: pricing_onepager.pdf (for reference)]

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@horizonhealth.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@horizonhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: three-window demo proposal + procurement & security intro

Marcus — thanks for the clear follow-up and the MAP. Appreciate the windows.

Quick responses:
- Procurement: looping Olivia (cc) and procurement@horizonhealth.ai here. Procurement will want a pricing one-pager + an estimated PO timeline (we’re targeting Nov 15 for PO cut).
- Security: I’ll introduce the security lead after I confirm availability (likely Olivia or another ops lead). Primary concern is multi-tenant data isolation and encryption at rest.

Of the three windows, Wed Oct 27 14:00–15:00 PT looks best for our team. If that’s still open on your side, let’s pencil that in. If you can send a short agenda (45m tech + 15m procurement Q&A), that would be perfect.

Also, can you share the SOC2 report or a summary? Olivia requested it before the deep dive.

—Sam
Sam Reynolds
Director of Platform Engineering, Horizon Health
sam@horizonhealth.ai

Hi Sam / Olivia — happy to take point on evidence and the security portion of the upcoming deep dive. Thanks for proposing Oct 27 14:00–15:00 PT (that slot works for our security lead).

I’ll prepare:
- A 10–15m security overview slide (SOC2 summary, encryption model, network controls).
- A one-page evidence checklist we can share with procurement (what we can provide pre-NDA vs. after NDA).
- A short FAQ on tenant isolation and how we enforce logical separation (KV cache isolation, VPC/private deploy options).

Before the call, can Horizon provide:
1) Identity provider(s) you use for SSO (Okta/Azure AD/other)
2) Any data residency constraints (region-level)
3) Procurement contact and billing details Olivia or procurement provided

Proposed final confirmation: Wed Oct 27, 14:00–15:00 PT — I’ll put a calendar invite and include the draft evidence checklist and the SOC2-summary.pdf. If Horizon prefers a slightly shorter technical segment (45m) + 15m procurement, we’ll structure it that way.
